text:
mel: Heads-up — vendor red-team booked exploratory run on Wed 2026-04-15 09:00-17:00 PT. We need a short runbook for RBAC change windows, KMS read-only access for assessors, audit log preservation, vuln triage ownership, and a clear retest window.

owen: Scope link? Which environments are in scope (prod/staging)?

mel: In-scope: staging + canary prod path only. Not full prod. Scope doc: https://internal.redwood/sys/pt/2026-04-redteam-scope (private)

ash: RBAC — propose creating ephemeral assessor role with scoped perms for the window. Who signs off on role creation? @sania?

sania: I can approve ephemeral roles. Prefer timeboxed creds (max 4 hours) and scoped to read-only logs + read-only KMS decrypt-for-audit. Acceptance criteria for retest: fix deployed to staging, unit test/qa signoff, and evidence uploaded to evidence bucket.

leah: Evidence bucket path & packaging? We should use presigned uploads and a checksum manifest. I'll own packaging.

mel: Tracker: https://sheets.internal/redwood/pt-remed-tracker-2026 (edit access for sec, eng leads). Please add rows for any findings during the engagement. File-naming: <ticket>-<short-title>-<timestamp>.zip

owen: Minimal IAM snippet for ephemeral role (for ops to review):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow", "Action":["logs:DescribeLogGroups","logs:GetLogEvents","s3:GetObject"], "Resource":"arn:aws:logs:*:*:*"}
  ]
}
```

ash: KMS notes — assessors need decrypt-to-temp for log inspection but should not be able to export keys. We'll create a KMS-grant that allows kms:Decrypt for the ephemeral principal and audit all GrantCreate/Retire events. Also ensure key usage logged to CloudTrail.

security-bot: New PT scheduled: created checklist ticket SEC-PT-2026-0415 and generated ephemeral-role request template.

deploy-bot: If you give me a role name I can pre-generate presigned upload URLs and a readroom with limited network IPs. Ping me with `!prepare <role>` in this thread.

leah: I'll take packaging and presigned URL flow. Can someone confirm retention window for preserved logs?

sania: Retain full audit logs for 90 days as immutable snapshot, plus a 14-day hot window for SIEM sampling. We'll export to s3://redwood-pt-archives/<engagement>/YYYYMMDD/

mel: Triage ownership: first 24h after findings -> security on-call (sania) to bucket by severity. 24-72h -> eng owner (assign in tracker). Critical fixes should aim for hotfix within 48h when feasible.

owen: Propose retest cadence: initial retest window opens 7 days after report upload; vendor to request slot via tracker; we reserve two 3-hour slots per week for retests for 3 weeks. Agree?

ash: +1. Also want a QA checklist for regression tests before retest signoff. I'll drop a template later.

leah: Will coordinate with SRE for canary routing and rollback playbook. Please don't push large infra changes during the test window.

mel: Action items:
- sania: approve ephemeral role template and create KMS grant policy (today end-of-day)
- owen: ops to review IAM snippet and schedule role creation window (tomorrow)
- leah: evidence bucket + presigned URL flow (today)
- ash: QA regression checklist (EOD)
- mel: set retest slots in tracker and notify vendor (after tracker filled)

ash: Quick Q — can assessors request temporary console access or only API/CLI? I prefer CLI/API only.

sania: CLI/API only. No console sessions. We will monitor all session tokens in real-time.

mel: Noted. We'll also snapshot trusted compute images pre-window and hash them: sha256: <placeholder>.

leah: For evidence manifest include: finding-id, affected-service, patch-PR link, deploy-id, logs-path, sha256 of bundle.

nowen: I'll add deploy-bot hook to automatically close tracker rows when deploy passes canary smoke tests.

mel: Great — if no objections I'll finalize the runbook and post a short checklist in #incidents later. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you've completed your action.

ash: :white_check_mark: (will do QA checklist)

sania: :white_check_mark: (will approve role)

leah: :white_check_mark: (packaging)

security-bot: Reminder scheduled: 48h before engagement to re-verify ephemeral role expiration time.

mel: Thanks all — logging this thread into tracker under SEC-PT-2026-0415.
